BITCELL_ROW_PITCH_CONTRACT.rule: Every real, dummy and replica row origin must be an exact integer multiple of the locked native row pitch.

BITCELL_COLUMN_PITCH_CONTRACT.rule: Every real, dummy and replica column origin must be an exact integer multiple of the locked native column pitch.

BITCELL_EDGE_ABUTMENT_CONTRACT.rule: Every intended storage-family seam has zero geometric gap and no unauthorized signal contact after flatten/union.

SAME_NET_POWER_RAIL_OVERLAP_CONTRACT.rule: Same-layer, same-net rails must overlap or abut into one final-GDS component; labels alone are not evidence.

PARENT_POWER_STITCH_CONTRACT.rule: A parent strap is valid only when every child endpoint has conductive overlap or a legal via/contact witness to it.

WL_DRIVER_ARRAY_SEAM_CONTRACT.rule: Each driver output is row-aligned to its array WL pin and the intended bank seam satisfies the locked abutment/channel policy.

DUMMY_ROW_COLUMN_CONTRACT.rule: Dummy rows and columns are explicit instances at every boundary required by the selected formal configuration.

TAP_INSERTION_CONTRACT.rule: Tap insertion follows a versioned maximum-spacing and power-polarity rule with explicit instances and witnesses.

REPLICA_CELL_COLUMN_CONTRACT.rule: Replica instances and pins are present only when required by the formal configuration and are bound to that configuration manifest.

PIN_ACCESS_CONTRACT.rule: WL, BL, BR, VDD and VSS access is proven on final clean GDS against obstruction and routing-track geometry.

HIERARCHICAL_CONNECTIVITY_CONTRACT.rule: The final hierarchy and flattened conductor graph agree on bit-exact WL/BL/BR mapping, isolated power nets and zero foreign-net merges.
